page.overview:
Who is LaDonna Belvedere?

Dr. LaDonna Belvedere was a scientist who was indirectly hired by Biosyn. She studied animals in their habitats. She is featured in the Jurassic Park: Raptors Hijack comic series.

Dr. Belvedere was funded by Biosyn before the events of the comic series. She released a gorilla into unfamiliar surroundings, which was the Colombian jungle to promote her study of animals in their habitats. Later on, she found two Velociraptors named Alf and Celia which previously fought the animal. As she observed them, Dr. Belvedere exhibited the same body language as the raptors. This leads to her being accepted by the raptors. She was confronted by Dr. Jeremiah Fischer (who was hired by CEO Bill Steingarten to get hold of the raptors) from the United States Army, who proposes starting a Biosyn version of Jurassic Park. She reluctantly accepts the role of head-keeper to support the raptor population. Dr. Belvedere continues to note the behaviour of the raptors albeit with immense remorse for their captivity. When Drs. Ellie Sattler and Ian Malcolm found out about the park, they break the raptors free, which end up killing several Biosyn officers and Dr. Fischer. Alf and Celia maul Dr. Belvedere to death despite her own signs of friendship.
